summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares one year versus two years of maintenance anti-PD-1 immunotherapy (pembrolizumab or dostarlimab) in people with advanced, metastatic, or recurrent endometrial cancer who have finished chemoimmunotherapy. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive either one year or two years of maintenance anti-PD-1 therapy, and the route and dosing frequency are not stated. The main outcome is progression-free survival, followed for at least 3 years from randomization; overall survival and immune-related adverse events are secondary outcomes.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara un año frente a dos años de inmunoterapia anti-PD-1 de mantenimiento (pembrolizumab o dostarlimab) en personas con cáncer endometrial avanzado, metastásico o recurrente que terminaron la quimioinmunoterapia. Los participantes se asignan al azar en proporción 1:1 a recibir un año o dos años de terapia anti-PD-1 de mantenimiento, y la vía de administración y la frecuencia de dosis no se indican. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión, con seguimiento de al menos 3 años desde la aleatorización; la supervivencia global y los eventos adversos relacionados con la inmunidad son resultados secundarios.
who_for: Advanced stage III or IV, or recurrent endometrial cancer.
Histological or cytological confirmation of any endometrial cancer subtype, including carcinosarcoma.
Completed standard carboplatin/taxol plus anti-PD-1 therapy, with a plan for maintenance anti-PD-1 therapy.
not_for: Tumors with unknown mismatch repair protein status.
Receiving other anticancer drugs such as bevacizumab, lenvatinib, or progestins, beyond chemo given with PD-1 drug at maintenance start.
